name: Daily Resets
description: Short, time-boxed routines that keep a small home livable, including a minimum version for rough days.
intro: Routines sized to the time you have: a few minutes on a rough day, ten on a normal one, more when you have it. Every time is a budget, not a promise.

name: Room Resets
description: Room-by-room checklists with a short list and a full list for the kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and living area.
intro: One room at a time, in an order that makes sense: clear, apply cleaner, wipe, floor last.

name: Safe Cleaning
description: Cleaning-product safety basics, each point tied to a poison-center, CDC or EPA source.
intro: What official sources actually say about mixing, ventilating, storing and reading labels on household cleaners.

name: Printables
description: Free checklists on US Letter paper that work in black and white. No email address needed.
intro: Print them, tape them inside a cabinet, write on them.
